Solicitation Profile
Supporting Extreme Risk Protection Order ERPO Infrastructure and Implementation

DCJS seeks applications to support Extreme Risk Protection Order ERPO infrastructure and implementation across the state. Approximately $19.5 million is expected to be available to support proposals that aim to implement innovative strategies to raise awareness of and increase the use of ERPOs as a tool to reduce firearm violence and save lives. Individual awards to law enforcement agencies are capped at $1.5 million per agency for allowable expenses fulfilling defined grant purposes and procedures. Strategies may include best practice interventions, training and coordination, and support for data collection on ERPO utilization. Projects that support behavioral health collaborations within the impacted community are encouraged. Please note, only local municipal police or sheriffs agencies in New York State, employing sworn officers with police powers are eligible to submit applications. This includes city, town, village, or tribal police departments as well as county sheriffs offices.

Questions about this Request for Applications RFA must be submitted to contact@example.ny.gov by Wednesday October 21, 2026. Responses to submitted questions will be posted on or about November 6, 2026.

The deadline for applications is Wednesday December 2, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. noon EST.

No prequalification necessary as only local units of government can apply.
